independent_code_reproduction.meaning: The reconstruction reproduces the retained R1 six-state propagator to numerical integration tolerance.

temporal_result.output_pair: (zeta,zeta_dot); rank is unchanged by nonzero rescaling to (zeta,2*a^3*G_S2*zeta_dot)
temporal_result.key_fact: The matter-only subblock [delta_m,v_m] has nonzero 2x2 determinant at every reported later epoch, so radiation is not required to span both temporal topographic directions.

spatial_result.isotropic_factorization: For an SO(4)-symmetric R1 background the same temporal transfer acts independently on each n=2 harmonic component.
spatial_result.full_relation: X_A(z)=U_XX(z) X_A(z_i)+U_XE(z) E_A(z_i), separately for A=1..9.
spatial_result.single_profile_condition: The one-profile reduction X=x e^T requires rank_spatial(X)<=1.
spatial_result.consequence: Because rank(U_XE)=2, generic multi-pattern environmental data can produce spatial rank 2. A single common profile/axis therefore requires aligned/factorized environmental n=2 data or an additional justified spatial reduction.
spatial_result.orientation_statement: The isotropic temporal dynamics can transmit an orientation already present in the environmental n=2 coefficients; they do not create a preferred axis from an isotropic state.

interpretation.what_is_closed: Within the frozen R1 late-time linear system, environmental density/velocity data can source both independent temporal components of the projected topographic state.
interpretation.what_is_not_closed: The physical initial/environmental conditions, their n=2 spatial coefficient tensors, and the microscopic BHSM-to-R1 normalization remain unspecified.
interpretation.state_selection_reframe: An isolated one-dimensional attractor is unnecessary. The correct prediction problem is coupled initial-state specification plus a justified spatial reduction.
interpretation.important_anchor_limit: Since the environmental basis is defined at z=2.1, this calculation does not derive the z=2.1 X2 from earlier environmental history. It shows how specified environmental data at the anchor affect later topographic evolution.
